_comment: Each hobby becomes a section on /hobbies/. 'lists' are titled groups. A list has either 'items' (strings → tags, or { "title": "...", "author": "...", "note": "..." } → books) or 'text' (a short paragraph). Items with "placeholder": true are shown as labelled placeholders. 'links' are optional: { "label": "...", "url": "https://..." } or a page on this site such as "travel/". 'showCountries': true lists the countries from travel.json.
intro: Outside research, I spend much of my free time with plants, books and travel.

hobbies.title: Plants & balcony gardening
hobbies.summary: A long-standing, hands-on hobby. I keep a small indoor collection and a balcony garden, and I enjoy propagating new plants from cuttings. My approach is practical and low-intervention: the right light, patient watering and not too much fuss.

hobbies.title: Reading
hobbies.summary: I read a lot growing up, and somewhere in adult life the habit slipped away. I am now rebuilding it, one book at a time.

lists.title: My goal
lists.text: Start with one book a month, then move to two a month, and keep building from there.

hobbies.title: Travel
hobbies.summary: Travel is one of my favourite ways to spend time away from research: exploring new places, their food and their landscapes.
